sources.q10: Median Q10 of the vegetables with derived values (no usable respiration data)
sources.sl_ref_hours: Ambient life 72-120 h at unstated temperature (taken as 25 C), converted to 25 C with Q10; https://arccjournals.com/journal/agricultural-science-digest/D-5985
sources.alpha: Median alpha of the vegetables calibrated on NABCONS 2022; no loss row for this crop
sources.second_life: Processing: pickle (vinegar), minimally processed cucumber (https://niftem-t.ac.in/olapp/pmfme/upload/mt_handbook_0.pdf); Recover: biogas, compost (D19)
sources.water_l_per_kg: Mekonnen and Hoekstra 2010, Report 47, global average, row 'Cucumbers and gherkins', https://www.waterfootprint.org/resources/Report47-WaterFootprintCrops-Vol1.pdf
